candidates.quote: Claw-back provisions are included if necessary, upon termination, the Owner shall pay the County all payments then due under this Agreement, including but not limited to the Deferred Amount, within sixty (60) calendar days.

candidates.quote: Thereafter, the required payment for these affordable units will increase by two percent (2%) for each subsequent tax year.
